lyrics.english: You’ve turned my world upside down, It’s filled with you

lyrics.romanization: maeiri haengbokhal sun eopgetjiman, igeotman yaksokhalge

lyrics.english: Even from Venus to Mars, I’ll run to you, promise

I’ll be with you everywhere my memories can reach

lyrics.original: And you became my seven, 저 무지개의 색은

lyrics.english: And you became my seven, The colors of that rainbow
